sp_widget.name: WRM FAQ
sp_widget.script:
(function() { // Content lives here rather than in a knowledge base. That means // edits need widget access — fine for a short, stable list. data.faqs = [ { question: 'How do I book a workspace?', open: false, answer: '

Select Request a reservation at the top of this page, ' + 'then choose your workspace and the times you need it.

' + '

Location fills in automatically from the workspace you pick, so you ' + 'don\'t need to set it. Start times in the past aren\'t accepted, and the ' + 'end time must be after the start.

' + '

Your request goes for approval and appears in My reservations ' + 'straight away marked Pending approval. Once approved it becomes a ' + 'confirmed reservation with its own number.

' }, { question: 'What do the reservation statuses mean?', open: false, answer: '

Pending approval — submitted, waiting for someone to approve it.

' + '

Pending check-in — approved and the space is held for you, ' + 'but you haven\'t arrived yet.

' + '

Checked-in — you\'re using the space now.

' + '

Checked-out — finished, and the space has been released.

' + '

While a reservation is pending check-in or checked in, the workspace is held ' + 'and won\'t show as available to anyone else.

' }, { question: 'How do I check in and check out?', open: false, answer: '

Both are done from My reservations on this page.

' + '

A Check in button appears on your reservation row. You can ' + 'check in from one hour before your start time until the reservation ends. If you ' + 'try earlier, the portal tells you exactly when check-in opens.

' + '

Once checked in, the button becomes Check out. Checking out ' + 'releases the workspace immediately, so please check out when you leave rather than ' + 'letting the reservation run to its end time.

' } ,{ question: 'What happens if I don\'t check in?', open: false, answer: '

If you don\'t check in, the workspace team can mark your reservation as a ' + 'No-show.

' + '

A space held by a reservation nobody turns up for is a space nobody else ' + 'could book, so please let the team know as early as you can if your plans ' + 'change.

' }, { question: 'How do I cancel a reservation?', open: false, answer: '

Reservations can\'t currently be cancelled from this portal. Contact the ' + 'workspace team and they\'ll cancel it for you.

' + '

Cancelling releases the workspace straight away so someone else can book it, ' + 'so it\'s worth doing as soon as you know you won\'t need the space.

' } ]; })();
sp_widget.template: Common questions
